items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I worked with him two times, yeah. ... I played with him a couple of times.

ctx.x: His name was C. P. Johnson. And this was in -- I tell you when -- I know exactly when this happened. This was about '47, because I was working with Norman Granz, and the tour ended up in the dead of winter in Toledo, Ohio, and it was so cold; at the end of every tour, Norman would ask us where did we want to go, and we started to -- New York.

So I told him I wanted to go to California, you know, and to get out of that cold weather. And Roy was coming out in California at that time. I think I mentioned this to you the other day. Roy Eldridge, he had a gig, Billy Berg's -- did I tell you about that?
